name: City of Encinitas
disclaimer: Verify current standards with the City of Encinitas Development Services Department. Coastal areas are also subject to Coastal Commission review.

notes: Coastal Zone properties may require a Coastal Development Permit (CDP) — verify at CA Coastal Commission.
Encinitas Municipal Code adopted ADU regulations consistent with state law.
Some properties in the Cardiff-by-the-Sea and Olivenhain areas have specific overlay zones.

coastal.note: Properties west of Interstate 5 or within the Coastal Zone boundary require Coastal Development Permit review. Confirm at City Planning or CA Coastal Commission.
